mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PEACH_ROLE_DATA_POLICY (ID, TENANT_REF_ID, APP_REF_ID, ROLE_REF_ID, PERMISSION_REF_ID, DATA_SCOPE, ORG_REF_ID, STATUS, IS_DELETE, VERSION, CREATED_TIME, CREATOR_ID) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantRefId}, #{appRefId}, #{roleRefId}, #{permissionRefId}, #{dataScope}, #{orgRefId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'ACTIVE', 0, 0, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), #{operatorRefId})
